caption: The drawing depicts a single woven basket centered on a plain, light beige background. The basket has a bulbous, round shape with a narrower, slightly elevated rim at the top, giving it a jar-like appearance. Its surface is illustrated with meticulous lines and shading to indicate the texture of coiled or woven fiber, primarily in shades of brown with subtle variations ranging from light tan to darker brown. There are no other objects, patterns, or decorations on either the basket or the background. Below and to the right of the basket image, the name "CHARLOTTE ANGUS" is typed in small capital letters.
title: Bee Basket and Cover
